title: Deep Learning-Based Causal Inference for Large-Scale Combinatorial Experiments: Theory and Empirical Evidence
authors: Zikun Ye; Zhiqi Zhang; Dennis Zhang; Heng Zhang; Renyu Zhang
eligible_reason: Debiased deep learning for combinatorial randomized A/B tests on a video platform (three treatments, user-level). Randomized experiment analysis; no panel DiD or staggered adoption.
design_notes: Python notebooks (main.ipynb, figure1.ipynb, synthetic_experiments.ipynb). OLS appears only as a benchmark estimator of treatment-combination effects.
data_files_note: empirics/README.md: to protect sensitive data, the data files contain synthetic data only.
data_provenance_note: Synthetic user-level data stand in for the proprietary platform data.
